problem: Find $B=\overset{―}{A}$, where $A=[\begin{aligned}-2+\text{i} & 4 & -\text{i} \\ -5\text{i} & 7-5\text{i} & 1 \\ 3-2\text{i} & \text{i} & 0\end{aligned}].$ What is the value of ${b}_{13}+{b}_{31}?$
worked_solution:
Taking the complex conjugate of each entry, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\overset{―}{A} & =\overset{―}{[\begin{aligned}-2+\text{i} & 4 & -\text{i} \\ -5\text{i} & 7-5\text{i} & 1 \\ 3-2\text{i} & \text{i} & 0\end{aligned}]} \\  & =[\begin{aligned}\overset{―}{-2+\text{i}} & \overset{―}{4} & \overset{―}{-\text{i}} \\ \overset{―}{-5\text{i}} & \overset{―}{7-5\text{i}} & \overset{―}{1} \\ \overset{―}{3-2\text{i}} & \overset{―}{\text{i}} & \overset{―}{0}\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}-2-\text{i} & 4 & \text{i} \\ 5\text{i} & 7+5\text{i} & 1 \\ 3+2\text{i} & -\text{i} & 0\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, ${b}_{13}+{b}_{31}=\text{i}+(3+2\text{i})=3+3\text{i}.$
